scope: No training, model changes, GPU jobs or raw data transfer. Read-only scans and aggregate local outputs.
validation: Independent unseen2048 recomputation matches complete scan exactly
Class counts and weighted class loss match all-group metrics
Prefix unique-count histograms exhaust all questions
important_interpretation: Token duplicate rates are not exact hidden tensor duplicate rates
All5 identical is distinct from pairwise duplicate rate
Mixed BCE in trainer is over all groups, not just true Mixed groups
Losses recomputed from saved FP32 sigmoid p may slightly differ from original stable-logit BCE due to sigmoid saturation
Replacing each group p_j by its mean is a posthoc sensitivity check, not a retraining causal experiment
